INC-1047 — Account lockout
Priority: P2 High | Status: Resolved
Requester: Jasmine Brooks | Finance
Device: FIN-LT-022

Issue: The requester could not sign in because her account was locked.

Investigation: Verified the requester’s identity through the simulated approved callback process. Inspected the phone’s mail configuration and found stored credentials from before the latest password change.

Root cause: The phone continued authenticating with an outdated password, causing repeated account lockouts.

Resolution: Asked the requester to remove the outdated stored credentials and authenticate with the current password. Unlocked the account after correcting the source of the failed authentication attempts.

Verification: The requester successfully signed in and confirmed that access was restored.

Lesson learned: Unlocking an account alone does not address the device or application causing repeated failed sign-ins.

INC-1048 — Forgotten password
Priority: P3 Normal | Status: Resolved
Requester: Marcus Lee | Sales
Device: SAL-LT-014

Issue: The requester forgot his password after returning from vacation.

Investigation: Confirmed the reported sign-in problem and verified the requester’s identity before resetting the password.

Root cause: The requester could not recall his current password.

Resolution: Reset the password and required a password change at the next sign-in. Explained the next sign-in steps without recording credentials in the ticket.

Verification: The simulated requester confirmed that account access was restored.

Lesson learned: Verify identity before resetting credentials and document the outcome without including passwords.

INC-1049 — Finance shared drive access denied
Priority: P3 Normal | Status: Resolved
Requester: Ava Patel | Finance
Device: FIN-LT-009

Issue: After transferring from Sales to Finance, the requester could sign in but could not access the Finance share.

Investigation: Verified identity and reviewed account group membership. Identified that the account was missing the Finance-Read security group required for department access.

Root cause: Missing Finance-Read membership. After membership was added, the existing sign-in token still needed to be refreshed.

Resolution: Added the required Finance-Read membership and asked the requester to sign out and sign back in to refresh the security group token.

Verification: The requester opened the Finance share successfully and confirmed restored access.

Lesson learned: A group membership change may require a new sign-in before the user’s session reflects the updated permissions.

INC-1050 — Intranet will not load  
Priority: P2 High  
Requester: Noah Reed | Operations  
Device: OPS-PC-031  
Status: Resolved

Issue: The requester could not access the company intranet by name.

Investigation: Checked IP and DHCP configuration. The workstation had an active lease but was configured to use public DNS, 8.8.8.8. Name resolution for intranet.northstar.example failed, while a direct connection to 10.20.0.20 succeeded.

Root cause: The workstation was using a DNS server that could not resolve the company’s internal intranet name.

Resolution: Set the preferred DNS server to 10.20.0.10 and cleared the resolver cache. Repeated the name lookup successfully.

Verification: The requester confirmed that the intranet worked.

Environment: NorthStar IT Support Lab — simulated training environment.
